title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第六章、空房珠花

    公孙策和包拯划着船向无人岛去。
    天色越来越暗，空中飘着细雪。公孙策加快了划船的速度，但划了两个小时，那小岛仍然只是一个黑点。“不行，我们得在天黑前上岛。”包拯学着公孙策的样子着急地也划起了船。
    四个多小时后，他们终于到了无人岛。天已经黑了，夜空无一丝星光，还好有白雪的反光，他们能看清岛上的树木。他们停好船，上了岛。有条细细的小路从岸边通向树林的深处。
    “有人住在岛上。”公孙策看着小路说。
    包拯点点头，顺着小路向里走。树林里很安静，没有灯光，没有人声。大约二十分钟后，他们看到了两间草房。公孙策点亮一支火把，包拯推开房门，两人走了进去。
    房子里没有人，只有一张床、一张桌子和一把椅子，床上有被子。另一间房是厨房，里面放了一张小桌子，桌子上有碗筷。
    “是什么人住在这里？”公孙策吃惊地问。
    包拯仔细观察后说道：“每件东西都很旧，但都很干净。人应该离开不久，而且离开的时候并不慌乱，是个仔细而且沉着的人。”
    “是昨天和八王爷在一条船上的那个女人吗？”
    “很有可能。”包拯皱起了眉头，他在思考。
    公孙策不想打扰包拯，安静地在床边坐下了。他不小心撞倒了被子，伸手去扶，手摸到一个冰凉的东西。他把东西从被子下面拿了出来，是件首饰——一枝女子用来戴在头发上的珠花。
    “包拯，你看！”公孙策叫道。
    包拯吃惊地把火把举近，这是一枝珍珠做的珠花，十多颗白色的珍珠围成一个圈，圈中间有一颗紫色的珍珠，在火光下闪着淡淡的光，十分漂亮。
    “这……我好像在哪儿见过……”包拯说。
    公孙策一听就笑了：“这一看就是女子的东西，你在哪个女子那里见过？”
    灵光一闪，包拯想起来了：“宫里！宫里的宫女头上戴的珠花！是不是和这个很像？”
    公孙策的笑容没有了，他想了想，不情愿地点头：“你说得没错，是宫女的珠花，我在宫里看到过这样的。”
    果然，还是和皇宫有关。
    被子下面好像还有东西，包拯推开被子，一张压在下面的纸露了出来。纸上有字，他拿起来，借着火光读出声：
    “包拯，你的任务是查案，等案子查清了，八王爷自然就安全了。在查案过程中，不管你查到什么、查到哪一步，都要在城西菜市场挂旗将情况告诉给城中百姓。如果不这样做，八王爷会有危险。”
fullText.traditional:
第六章、空房珠花

    公孫策和包拯划著船向無人島去。
    天色越來越暗，空中飄著細雪。公孫策加快了划船的速度，但划了兩個小時，那小島仍然只是一個黑點。“不行，我們得在天黑前上島。”包拯學著公孫策的樣子著急地也划起了船。
    四個多小時後，他們終於到了無人島。天已經黑了，夜空無一絲星光，還好有白雪的反光，他們能看清島上的樹木。他們停好船，上了島。有條細細的小路從岸邊通向樹林的深處。
    “有人住在島上。”公孫策看著小路說。
    包拯點點頭，順著小路向裡走。樹林裡很安靜，沒有燈光，沒有人聲。大約二十分鐘後，他們看到了兩間草房。公孫策點亮一支火把，包拯推開房門，兩人走了進去。
    房子裡沒有人，只有一張床、一張桌子和一把椅子，床上有被子。另一間房是廚房，裡面放了一張小桌子，桌子上有碗筷。
    “是什麼人住在這裡？”公孫策吃驚地問。
    包拯仔細觀察後說道：“每件東西都很舊，但都很乾淨。人應該離開不久，而且離開的時候並不慌亂，是個仔細而且沉著的人。”
    “是昨天和八王爺在一條船上的那個女人嗎？”
    “很有可能。”包拯皺起了眉頭，他在思考。
    公孫策不想打擾包拯，安靜地在床邊坐下了。他不小心撞倒了被子，伸手去扶，手摸到一個冰涼的東西。他把東西從被子下面拿了出來，是件首飾——一枝女子用來戴在頭髮上的珠花。
    “包拯，你看！”公孫策叫道。
    包拯吃驚地把火把舉近，這是一枝珍珠做的珠花，十多顆白色的珍珠圍成一個圈，圈中間有一顆紫色的珍珠，在火光下閃著淡淡的光，十分漂亮。
    “這……我好像在哪兒見過……”包拯說。
    公孫策一聽就笑了：“這一看就是女子的東西，你在哪個女子那裡見過？”
    靈光一閃，包拯想起來了：“宮裡！宮裡的宮女頭上戴的珠花！是不是和這個很像？”
    公孫策的笑容沒有了，他想了想，不情願地點頭：“你說得沒錯，是宮女的珠花，我在宮裡看到過這樣的。”
    果然，還是和皇宮有關。
    被子下面好像還有東西，包拯推開被子，一張壓在下面的紙露了出來。紙上有字，他拿起來，借著火光讀出聲：
    “包拯，你的任務是查案，等案子查清了，八王爺自然就安全了。在查案過程中，不管你查到什麼、查到哪一步，都要在城西菜市場掛旗將情況告訴給城中百姓。如果不這樣做，八王爺會有危險。”

sentences.simplified: 果然，还是和皇宫有关。
sentences.traditional: 果然，還是和皇宮有關。
sentences.pinyin: guǒ rán hái shi hé huáng gōng yǒu guān
sentences.english: Sure enough, it was indeed related to the palace.

sentences.simplified: 被子下面好像还有东西，
sentences.traditional: 被子下面好像還有東西，
sentences.pinyin: bèi zi xià miàn hǎo xiàng hái yǒu dōng xi
sentences.english: There seemed to be something else under the quilt.

sentences.simplified: 包拯推开被子，一张压在下面的纸露了出来。
sentences.traditional: 包拯推開被子，一張壓在下面的紙露了出來。
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng tuī kāi bèi zi yì zhāng yā zài xià miàn de zhǐ lòu le chu lai
sentences.english: Bao Zheng pushed the quilt aside, and a piece of paper that was pressed underneath was revealed.

sentences.simplified: 纸上有字，他拿起来，借着火光读出声：
sentences.traditional: 紙上有字，他拿起來，借著火光讀出聲：
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ shang yǒu zì tā ná qǐ lái jiè zhe huǒ guāng dú chū shēng
sentences.english: There were words on the paper. He picked it up and read aloud by the torchlight:

sentences.simplified: “包拯，你的任务是查案，等案子查清了，八王爷自然就安全了。
sentences.traditional: “包拯，你的任務是查案，等案子查清了，八王爺自然就安全了。
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng nǐ de rèn wu shì chá àn děng àn zi chá qīng le bā wáng ye zì rán jiù ān quán le
sentences.english: “Bao Zheng, your task is to investigate the case. Once the case is solved, the Eight Prince will naturally be safe.

sentences.simplified: 在查案过程中，不管你查到什么、查到哪一步，
sentences.traditional: 在查案過程中，不管你查到什麼、查到哪一步，
sentences.pinyin: zài chá àn guò chéng zhōng bù guǎn nǐ chá dào shén me chá dào nǎ yí bù
sentences.english: During the investigation, no matter what you find or how far you get, ..

sentences.simplified: 都要在城西菜市场挂旗将情况告诉给城中百姓。
sentences.traditional: 都要在城西菜市場掛旗將情況告訴給城中百姓。
sentences.pinyin: dōu yào zài chéng xī cài shì chǎng guà qí jiāng qíng kuàng gào su gěi chéng zhōng bǎi xìng
sentences.english: .. you must hang a flag at the market in the city’s west to inform the townspeople of the situation.

sentences.simplified: 如果不这样做，八王爷会有危险。”
sentences.traditional: 如果不這樣做，八王爺會有危險。”
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ bú zhè yàng zuò bā wáng ye huì yǒu wēi xiǎn
sentences.english: If you do not do this, the Eighth Prince will be in danger.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 6:  A Hairpin in an Empty Room
Gongsun Ce and Bao Zheng rowed a boat towards the uninhabited island.
The sky was getting darker, and fine snow was drifting in the air.
Gongsun Ce quickened his rowing pace, but after two hours of rowing, the small island was still just a black dot.
“This won’t do, we must reach the island before dark.” Imitating Gongsun Ce, Bao Zheng also began frantically rowing the boat.
More than four hours later, they finally arrived at the uninhabited island.
The sky had already darkened, and there was no trace of starlight in the night sky.
Fortunately, the reflection of the white snow allowed them to see the trees on the island clearly.
They docked the boat and went ashore. A narrow path led from the shore into the depths of the forest.
“Someone lives on the island,” Gongsun Ce said, looking at the path.
Bao Zheng nodded and followed the path. The forest was very quiet, with no lights and no sounds of people.
About twenty minutes later, they saw two thatched cottages.
Gongsun Ce lit a torch, Bao Zheng pushed open the door, and the two of them walked in.
There was no one in the cottage, only a bed, a table, and a chair. There was a quilt on the bed.
The other room was the kitchen, where there was a small table with bowls and chopsticks on it.
“Who lives here?” Gongsun Ce asked in surprise.
After careful observation, Bao Zheng said, “Every item is very old, but they all are very clean.
It seems that the person left not long ago, and they did not leave in a hurry. This is a very meticulous and calm person.”
“Is this the woman who was on the boat with the Eighth Prince yesterday?”
“Very likely.” Bao Zheng furrowed his brow and was thinking.
Gongsun Ce did not want to disturb Bao Zheng and quietly sat down by the bedside.
He accidentally knocked over the quilt and reached his hand out to catch it. His hand touched something cold.
He took it out from under the quilt. It was a piece of jewelry—a hairpin meant for a woman to wear in her hair.
“Bao Zheng, look!” Gongsun Ce called out.
Bao Zheng raised the torch closer in astonishment. It was a hairpin adorned with pearls.
More than ten white pearls formed a circle, with a purple pearl in the middle.
It shimmered with a faint light under the torchlight. It was extremely beautiful.
“This … I feel like I’ve seen it somewhere before …” Bao Zheng said.
Gongsun Ce smiled when he heard this: “This is obviously a woman’s item. Which woman did you see it on?”
A sudden flash of inspiration hit Bao Zheng, and he remembered:
“In the palace! The hairpins worn by the palace maids! Don’t they look a lot like this?”
Gongsun Ce’s smile disappeared. He thought for a moment and reluctantly nodded:
“You’re right, it’s a palace maid’s hairpin. I’ve seen ones like this in the palace before.”
Sure enough, it was indeed related to the palace.
There seemed to be something else under the quilt.
Bao Zheng pushed the quilt aside, and a piece of paper that was pressed underneath was revealed.
There were words on the paper. He picked it up and read aloud by the torchlight:
“Bao Zheng, your task is to investigate the case. Once the case is solved, the Eight Prince will naturally be safe.
During the investigation, no matter what you find or how far you get, ..
.. you must hang a flag at the market in the city’s west to inform the townspeople of the situation.
If you do not do this, the Eighth Prince will be in danger.”
